code='''def transform(grid):
    src=[row[:] for row in grid]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(src),len(src[0])
    remaining={(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if src[r][c]==1}
    arrows=[]
    while remaining:
        seed=remaining.pop(); stack=[seed]; comp={seed}
        while stack:
            r,c=stack.pop()
            for q in ((r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1)):
                if q in remaining:
                    remaining.remove(q); comp.add(q); stack.append(q)
        arrows.append(comp)
    for comp in arrows:
        rows=[r for r,c in comp]; cols=[c for r,c in comp]
        top,bottom,left,right=min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols)
        specs=[('up',top-1,-1),('down',bottom+1,1)]
        done=False
        for name,start,step in specs:
            if not done and 0<=start<h and any(src[start][c] not in (0,1,8) for c in range(left,right+1)):
                first=[src[start][c] for c in range(left,right+1)]
                second=[src[start+step][c] for c in range(left,right+1)]
                rr=start; k=0
                while 0<=rr<h:
                    pat=first if k%2==0 else second
                    for j,c in enumerate(range(left,right+1)): out[rr][c]=pat[j]
                    rr+=step; k+=1
                done=True
        if done: continue
        for name,start,step in [('left',left-1,-1),('right',right+1,1)]:
            if 0<=start<w and any(src[r][start] not in (0,1,8) for r in range(top,bottom+1)):
                first=[src[r][start] for r in range(top,bottom+1)]
                second=[src[r][start+step] for r in range(top,bottom+1)]
                cc=start; k=0
                while 0<=cc<w:
                    pat=first if k%2==0 else second
                    for i,r in enumerate(range(top,bottom+1)): out[r][cc]=pat[i]
                    cc+=step; k+=1
                break
    return out
'''
